visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short salt-and-pepper hair and a goatee stands against a bright white, seemingly infinite studio background, wearing a dark traditional-style robe with intricate patterned trim. He keeps his eyes closed in a focused, meditative expression, holding his head slightly tilted as if in deep concentration. (2) He meticulously lights sticks of incense from the flickering orange flame of a tall, thick red candle placed on a table. Smoke curls upwards in thin grey wisps as he moves the incense through the air with controlled movements, his facial expression remaining solemn and composed throughout the process. (3) The camera provides a close-up focus on his weathered hands as he carefully handles a long, dark red cylindrical object, possibly a container for ceremonial items. The lighting highlights the texture of the skin on his hands and the smooth surface of the object, emphasizing a high level of attention to detail. (4) He inserts the smoking incense into a holder while performing fluid, ritualistic hand gestures that suggest a spiritual or traditional ceremony. His eyes remain closed, and the bright, high-key studio lighting creates a stark contrast between his dark clothing and the clean background, focusing all attention on his actions. (5) Large, stylized black Chinese characters reading "山海夜行誌" appear as a central title overlay, accompanied by smaller text above it. The man continues his slow, rhythmic ritualistic movements behind the text in a semi-transparent or slightly blurred layer, creating a sense of depth and mystery. (6) A rapid sequence of individual portraits introduces four different people, each with their name appearing in large vertical white text. They pose with varied, dramatic expressions—serious, contemplative, and looking upwards—against dark, moody backgrounds with blue and gold lens flares. (7) A promotional poster graphic fills the screen, showcasing traditional Chinese artwork of mythical figures in shades of green and red. The poster displays essential event details such as "06/07 @西門町" and "嘖嘖現正募資中", using bold typography to grab the viewer's attention during this informative phase. (8) The man from the first scene returns to the frame, leaning in close to the red candle to blow out the flame with a focused breath. As the light from the candle disappears, the screen quickly fades to a solid black, signifying the conclusion of the ritualistic segment. (9) A final black screen displays white stylized text for the production company "我的預算有限公司" (MY BUDGET COMPANY LIMITED) in both Chinese and English characters. The text is centered and clearly legible, providing a professional closing credit.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track begins with a low-frequency ambient drone and a mysterious, shimmering synth pad, creating a tense and ritualistic atmosphere. There are no human voices present, allowing the listener to focus on the cold, expansive acoustic space. (2) A deep male voice enters, chanting a poetic Chinese verse with a calm, resonant, and professional narrative tone. The speech rate is slow and deliberate, with a low pitch level and significant vocal breathiness that adds to the mysterious quality. (3) A sharp "click" sound, likely from a ceremonial tool, triggers a new phase where the chanting continues over a steady, slightly muffled rhythmic pulse. The BGM remains in a minor mode, maintaining a sense of unease or traditional gravitas. (4) A loud "whoosh" transition SFX marks a dramatic shift into a high-energy electronic track with a driving beat, approximately 125 BPM. The music becomes the dominant layer, featuring sharp synthesized orchestral stabs and high spectral brightness. (5) A series of rapid "impact" and camera shutter SFX are layered over the high-tempo music, perfectly synchronized with the fast visual cuts. These short-duration sound events increase the acoustic density and energy level, creating a feeling of modern excitement. (6) The high-energy music reaches a peak with vocal stings before a sudden "puff" sound occurs as a candle is blown out. This is followed by a final, decaying synthetic chime and a minimalist production logo sound.
